input.subject: URGENT: water leak into kitchen ceiling and light fitting - 2 Alder Mews, ref HC-4-077
input.body:
Dear Mr Quill,

We understand you are away, but need to let you know about an emergency at 2 Alder Mews, Cobham Fold, ZZ4 4ZZ (ref HC-4-077).

The kitchen ceiling stain reported on 20 September has worsened: the tenant reports water dripping steadily, the ceiling sagging in the middle, and the light fitting above the cooker wet and flickering. The bathroom is directly above, so a leak from the bathroom is likely.

Because there is a risk of electrical danger and ceiling collapse, we are treating this as emergency safety work and arranging urgent attendance (leak tracing/isolation and an electrical safety check) without waiting for prior approval. We have given the tenant safety instructions. We will send you details and costs as soon as we have them, and any further repairs beyond making the property safe will come to you for approval.

If you have a preferred plumber or electrician, or any instructions, please reply or call us.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
